title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Cass/1 -> HHb CDR 800 PRO via analog i/o
source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-300s w/CP-4 Shotguns -> Sony WM-D6 -> WM-D6(M-Cass)

ai_review.summary: High‑fidelity audience recording (Sennheiser 441 → Sony D5 → Marantz 330D) captures the early Ventura beach shows with a warm, loving vibe.
ai_review.review: The tape was sourced from a solid Sennheiser microphone chain feeding a Sony DAT and Marantz cassette deck, which reviewers note as a clean and well‑preserved capture. Although no specific songs are highlighted, the show is remembered fondly as the first Dead performances on the Ventura beach, with a carefree camping scene that adds to its charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one five‑star review; it praises the source chain and overall vibe but offers no detailed musical critique, so rating leans high but confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded via Sennheiser 441 mic into a Sony D5 DAT and Marantz 330D cassette deck – reviewers imply clear, well‑balanced audio with no noted flaws.
